Name: Better Interaction Hitboxes
Author: Tara864
Description:
Stand within the usual interaction range and right-click as you normally would. Click a keg lid while holding fruit to load it, or click it with an empty hand to collect finished wine. The mod adjusts which tile your click targets. The game and your other mods still handle recipes, fuel, inventory changes, and collection. Modded machines that use standard placed-object interactions can benefit automatically. Machines with custom controls or unusually large sprites may behave differently.
[heading]Settings[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Click tolerance[/b] — Adds a small margin around the target. The default is [b]8 pixels[/b], or one-eighth of a tile. Set it anywhere from 0 to 32 pixels.[/*]
[*][b]Prefer placed objects[/b] — Enabled by default. When a NPC and a machine overlap, the mod aims at the machine’s base tile first.[/*]
[*][b]Easier gift giving[/b] — Enabled by default. Click a NPC’s visible sprite while holding a gift. The usual gift limits still apply.[/*]
[/list]Change these settings in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], or edit
[code]config.json[/code]while the game is closed.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] for Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Extract the main download into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder. The resulting path should be
[code]Mods/BetterInteractionHitboxes/manifest.json[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional. All 12 official game interface languages are included and follow your in-game language setting.
[heading]Compatibility and credits[/heading]
Version 2.0.2 was built against [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.5.2[/b]. Multiplayer and split-screen have not been fully tested.
OpenAI Codex generated the C# implementation, translations, and mod page text. The mod’s design and revisions were guided by the author’s in-game feedback.

Downloads.Description: Load machines and collect finished goods from up to 2 tiles away by default. Click the visible part of a machine, including the top of a keg. Device reach is adjustable from 1 to 5 tiles. Includes all 12 game languages. Requires SMAPI.
